units.name: Accounting for Decision Making
tips: Always link financial data back to real-world business decisions.
Practice past exam questions on balance sheets and income statements.
Understand the difference between cash flow and profit.

units.name: Management and Organisations
tips: Apply management theories to real case studies for deeper understanding.
Learn how to structure an argumentative essay clearly.
Attend all workshops — discussion is where the concepts click.

units.name: Marketing Principles
tips: Memorise and apply the 7 Ps framework to analyse any business.
Keep up with current marketing campaigns to use as examples.
Practice writing a marketing plan with a real or fictional product.

units.name: Business Economics
tips: Draw supply-and-demand graphs by hand until they become intuitive.
Connect economic concepts to current news events.
Do practice calculations for elasticity and market equilibrium.

units.name: Strategic Management
tips: Use SWOT and PESTLE frameworks confidently in your analysis.
Read real business case studies from HBR or Ivey.
In group work, assign roles early and create a shared timeline.

units.name: Financial Management
tips: Practise NPV, IRR, and payback period calculations until they are automatic.
Understand the time value of money as the foundation of the unit.
Review past exams to find the most commonly tested calculations.
